author: John R. Hauser
modifications: Single polyglot C++/Slang integer-only value API; removed wrapper unions, function-pointer dispatch and gotos.
Fixed RNE only; removed all exception state, flags and other rounding modes; retained gradual underflow.
Canonicalized every NaN to 0xFFF8000000000000, including invalid operations.
Explicit uint32/uint64 and bounded signed int exponent arithmetic replace fast types.
Unsigned magnitude comparison/subtraction replaces signed significand difference.
CLZ byte table replaced with bounded binary-search shifts with defined zero handling.
Total guarded jam helper handles zero and full-width distances.
Portable four 32x32 product with carry and named high/low fields; no wide native arithmetic.
Normalization helpers inlined into multiplication/conversion; no out parameters or aliasing.
Packing remains additive; exact signed zero, infinity, underflow and tie behavior retained.

After NaN and infinity handling, multiplication by either exact finite +1 or -1 returns the other operand encoding with the unit operand sign XORed into its sign bit; both operand orders preserve subnormals and signed zeros without rounding.

Division and square-root special cases, subnormal normalization, result exponent/parity and fixed nearest-even round-pack derived from f64_div.c and f64_sqrt.c; exception state and NaN payload propagation removed under the existing canonical-NaN policy.

Replace upstream approximate reciprocal division and correction with exact restoring radix-2 significand division: one known leading bit and exactly 62 fractional digits, remainder always below a 53-bit divisor.

Replace upstream approximate reciprocal-square-root tables and correction with exact radix-4 restoring square root over 63 digit pairs of a conceptual 126-bit radicand (high 64 bits stored, low 64 bits zero); carry/subtraction arithmetic is defined unsigned modular arithmetic.

Division/sqrt reuse the existing jam and nearest-even round-pack; final nonzero remainder jams into bit0. Negative-exponent halving is explicit floor division without implementation-defined signed right shifts. All shifts have finite proved width bounds; no native wide integer or output reference was added.
scope: add, multiply, division, square root, widening binary32, quiet ordered comparisons and finiteness; fixed RNE/canonical NaNs, no exception model or general IEEE library

divsqrt_bounds.exponent_range: division round-pack exponent -1076..3119; sqrt half -537..511; signed arithmetic bounded
divsqrt_bounds.correction_policy: exact per-digit compare/subtract only, no convergence/retry loop
